title: report.requested (v1)
description: Dispatch of a report render. Published by job-orchestrator's outbox relay to `lean.jobs` with routing key `jobs.report.v1`, AMQP type `jobs.v1.ReportRequested`. Consumed by the report service (one render at a time per replica, GIL), which downloads `backtestResult` (and `liveResult`), runs `Report.Report` unchanged and uploads `report.html`/`report.pdf` to `lean-reports/<jobId>/<attempt>/`. The orchestrator resolves the source result references from the results service before publishing.

backtestResult.description: `backtest-data-source-file`: final result JSON of the source job (`job.completed.result`).
